paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
notes: Paper presents new 90% CL exclusion limits from SuperCDMS Soudan (CDMSlite + iZIP) on both dark photon kinetic mixing (epsilon) and ALP axioelectric coupling (g_ae) over 40 eV - 500 keV, assuming the candidate is all of galactic DM with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. Full limit curves are only in Figs. 12-13 (no tables); the only explicit numeric value in text is epsilon < ~1e-15 near 100 eV (dark photon), and g_ae < ~1e-12 at few-hundred eV for the ALP channel. Extracted the single text-stated dark photon point; confidence reduced because the full curve is not numerically available and the paper also constrains AxionElectron (g_ae ~ 1e-12 at a few hundred eV) as a separate result.
